items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: And he played with Burt Kelly quite a lot.

ctx.x: I was going to ask a little bit about... If you remember any of the other bands that Tom played with, like Ray Miller, do you know anything about his activities with Ray Miller, for instance?

Yes, he was playing... He played with what they call the Memphis Melody Boys. Ray Miller had the Memphis Melody Boys in Edwin's production show. I caught the show when I was in Chicago. And Tom was... The whole band was pushed up on pedestals, way up high in the scenery of the show. It was quite a large show. And that was in 1920 that I heard Tom in that particular band. And he went back to New York with them. And later on, he come back to Chicago. And he played with Burt Kelly quite a lot. Burt Kelly Stables was…
Yeah, we'd like to see him after a while.
